audio.source_references: Original AI-generated voices of Lin Hao, Xu Nuo and Zhang Wei
audio.background: Original ambience, separated locally with Demucs

script.speaker: linhao
script.text: I'm not sixteen yet, but I'm great at riding an e-bike. I'll be fine!

script.speaker: xunuo
script.text: But you're under sixteen! Riding an e-bike on the road is illegal and dangerous.

script.speaker: linhao
script.text: Oh, come on! It's our family e-bike. Just two minutes to the shop. What could go wrong?

script.speaker: zhangwei
script.text: Xu Nuo, my parents let me ride it. Not even nearby?

script.speaker: xunuo
script.text: Even with permission, rules still apply. We're under sixteen. We can't ride e-bikes on the road.

script.speaker: linhao
script.text: Yeah, you're right. I'll stick to my bicycle. The e-bike can wait till I'm sixteen.

script.speaker: zhangwei
script.text: Okay, no e-bike for me either. Come on, Lin Hao!
